groups.description: ONE electrical group a with SIX LC drawings. First quarter-period is the upper row of three; second quarter-period is the lower row of three. The zero-charge state appears separately at the end of the first row and the start of the second row. These are source subdivisions, not four generic quarter-cycle pictures. Each circuit has two capacitor plates on the left, top and bottom connecting wires and a four-lobe vertical coil on the right. No batteries/switches or numeric component values.

ONE mechanical group b with TWO spring pictures aligned in source with the quarter-period rows. Fixed hatched horizontal supports, vertical zigzag springs, round solid masses and a shared concept of a broken horizontal equilibrium reference. Top mass lies on the equilibrium line and carries vector-accent v_m (maximum velocity, NOT v_x); its rightward horizontal line is a position extension WITHOUT an arrowhead, NOT a horizontal velocity arrow. Lower mass lies ABOVE the equilibrium line, with a short solid horizontal mass-position connector to the right and a vertical marker spanning mass position and equilibrium, labelled vector-accent x_m. No numerical spring constant, mass or displacement value. The displacement marker is not a current arrow.
